{{samename|staff of the unreleased Game Boy Color game|Staff of Pokémon Picross (GBC)}}
This is a '''list of staff members''' who worked on the [[Spin-off Pokémon games|spin-off game]] [[Pokémon Picross]] for the [[Nintendo 3DS]], per the game's [[credits]]. It was published by [[Nintendo]] and developed by [[Jupiter Corporation]].
